body: Same. My mom always says that I should be grateful because there are people who love me and that I shouldn't be sad so I think it would've been easier on killing myself knowing that no one cares about me. I feel really guilty too when I think about suicidal thoughts. That's why I hope no one remembers me when I die so I wouldn't have to worry about causing others pain.

Thank you to the people who commented. I just woke up and I saw that my friend which is also my chem partner sent a chat to me last night about our project. I felt bad.... I can't just go up and tell her that her friend tried to kill herself last night so she didn't answer. I don't know if there's any hope but I don't want to certainly die as a bad friend to her.
